headline: Photographer by passion. Engineer by profession.
bio:
I'm Amal, based in Scarborough, Ontario. By day I work as an engineer. The rest of the time, there's a camera in my hand.

What keeps me going is simple: a love for the craft, and a wife who backs every early start and every late edit.

I photograph and film because moments pass quickly, and the precious, beautiful ones deserve to be kept.
